name: Key Points, Decisions, Tasks
description: Extract the essentials: key points, decisions made, and tasks to do.
source: Reconstructed from Plaud community template 'Key Points, Decisions, Tasks'.
outline: Extract and separate three things from the transcript: key points, decisions, and tasks.
List key points as concise bullets covering the substantive content.
List decisions that were explicitly made, each on its own line.
List tasks as a checklist with '- [ ] ', including owner and deadline when stated.
Keep it factual and grounded; omit a section entirely if nothing applies.
example:
## Key Points
- Budget approved for Q3

## Decisions
- Launch moves to 12 May

## Tasks
- [ ] Send the plan to finance (Sam, Fri)
